raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 (377 rows) has source_tz='UTC', while every other batch is America/Chicago local time (06:00-23:00 opening hours). Its timestamps were never converted, so evening Chicago transactions land at 00:00-05:00 on the next UTC date. This shifts both the early-morning timestamps and the txn_date assignment. Converting UTC rows to Chicago time (CST, UTC-6 in January) fixes it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
